title: Phase 2：規則 26 在偶數寬度環上的週期等於零邊界規則 90（OEIS A334504 偶數項猜想）

R3-L02.proof: paper proof and Lean proof for all m >= 2 (rule26_even_eventual_period); numeric check n <= 40 with two independent simulations against OEIS A268754 data

sources_checked: oeis online via claude-in-chrome (A268754; A334504 in DISC-0008-S002)
novelty.note: The statement is the A334504 FORMULA conjecture (Zabolotskii 2024). Both proof steps (rule 26 = rule 90 on the single-seed orbit; reflection-symmetric ring = null boundary) are known techniques. Not checked: arXiv, OpenAlex, MathSciNet, Math Fun.
